comments.content: The DirectML branch creates the causal mask with uninitialized memory (torch.empty) then only applies triu_(1) without fill_, so the upper-triangular entries retain arbitrary garbage values instead of the intended masking value. This will produce incorrect attention. If the intent is to avoid -inf on DirectML, you should still fill_ with a large negative finite value (e.g. -torch.finfo(x.dtype).max) before triu_, matching the original behavior minus the -inf issue.
